```{r Microglia_Pap1_control}
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(enrichplot)
library(dplyr)
library(gridExtra)
library(glmGamPoi)

## Microglia_pap1_vs_control
resDF <- resDF_Microglia_Pap1_control_13feb

resDF$Expression.Padjust <- "NO"
resDF$Expression.Padjust[resDF$lfc > 0.25 & resDF$adj_pval < 0.05] <- "UP"
resDF$Expression.Padjust[resDF$lfc < -0.25 & resDF$adj_pval < 0.05] <- "DOWN"

Microglia_Pap1_control <- resDF

table(Microglia_Pap1_control$Expression.Padjust)

write.csv(Microglia_Pap1_control, file = 'Microglia_Pap1_control.csv')

# Microglia_Pap1_control  Volcano
resDF <- Microglia_Pap1_control 
resDF$name <- resDF$...1
# Count groups
up_count <- sum(resDF$Expression.Padjust == "UP", na.rm = TRUE)
down_count <- sum(resDF$Expression.Padjust == "DOWN", na.rm = TRUE)
no_count <- sum(resDF$Expression.Padjust == "NO", na.rm = TRUE)

# Create legend label
legend_title <- paste0("Expression\nUP: ", up_count,
                       " | DOWN: ", down_count,
                       " | NS: ", no_count)

# Top 15 UP and DOWN
top_up <- resDF %>% filter(Expression.Padjust == "UP") %>% arrange(adj_pval) %>% head(10)
top_down <- resDF %>% filter(Expression.Padjust == "DOWN") %>% arrange(adj_pval) %>% head(10)
top_genes <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down)

# Create volcano plot with only inner panel border
volcano_plot <- ggplot(resDF, aes(x = lfc, y = -log10(adj_pval), color = Expression.Padjust)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.25, 0.25), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_text_repel(data = top_genes,
                    aes(label = name),
                    size = 6, max.overlaps = 200,
                    box.padding = 0.6, point.padding = 0.3,
                    segment.color = 'grey40') +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "red", "DOWN" = "blue", "NO" = "gray")) +
    labs(title = "Microglia_Pap1_control",
         x = "Log2 Fold Change",
         y = "-log10(AdjP-value)",
         color = legend_title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
        plot.background = element_blank()  # No outer border
    )
volcano_plot <- volcano_plot + xlim(-1.5, 1.5)
# Save square PDF
ggsave("Microglia_Pap1_control.Volcano.pdf",
       plot = volcano_plot,
       width = 7, height = 7)



### Microglia GO plot (UP, DOWN) PAP1 vs. Control
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichR)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
#### Subset for UP and DOWN
# Microglia_Pap1_control 
### Microglia GO plot (UP, DOWN) PAP1 vs. Control

library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichR)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)

#### Subset for UP and DOWN
# Microglia_Pap1_control 
Microglia.UP <- subset(Microglia_Pap1_control, Expression.Padjust == "UP")
Microglia.UP <- Microglia.UP$...1

Microglia.DOWN <- subset(Microglia_Pap1_control, Expression.Padjust == "DOWN")
Microglia.DOWN <- Microglia.DOWN$...1

## GO Enrichment for Microglia UP (PAP1 vs. CONTROL)
go_up <- enrichGO(
  gene = Microglia.UP,
  OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType = "SYMBOL",       # <- Correct keyType
  ont = "ALL",              # Ontologies: BP, MF, CC
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff = 1,         # No filtering yet
  readable = FALSE
)

go_down <- enrichGO(
  gene = Microglia.DOWN,
  OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType = "SYMBOL",
  ont = "ALL",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff = 1,
  readable = FALSE
)

# Extract and label results — use -log10(p.adjust) instead of NES
Microglia.GO_UP.result <- go_up@result
Microglia.GO_UP.result$logFDR <- -log10(Microglia.GO_UP.result$p.adjust)
Microglia.GO_UP.result$Expression <- "UP"
Microglia.GO_UP.result$Type <- "PAP1.vs.Control"

Microglia.GO_Down.result <- go_down@result
Microglia.GO_Down.result$logFDR <- -log10(Microglia.GO_Down.result$p.adjust)
Microglia.GO_Down.result$Expression <- "DOWN"
Microglia.GO_Down.result$Type <- "PAP1.vs.Control"

saveRDS(Microglia.GO_UP.result, file = 'Microglia.GO_UP.result.rds')
write.csv(Microglia.GO_UP.result, file = 'Microglia.GO_UP.result.csv')
saveRDS(Microglia.GO_Down.result, file = 'Microglia.GO_Down.result.rds')
write.csv(Microglia.GO_Down.result, file = 'Microglia.GO_Down.result.csv')

## GO plot
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Combine and process
go_combined <- rbind(
    Microglia.GO_UP.result %>% mutate(Regulation = "Upregulated"),
    Microglia.GO_Down.result %>% mutate(Regulation = "Downregulated")
)

# Z-score & first 3 unique gene symbols
go_combined <- go_combined %>%
    mutate(
        Zscore = ifelse(Regulation == "Downregulated", -logFDR, logFDR),
        GeneSymbols = sapply(strsplit(geneID, "/"), function(g) {
            unique_genes <- unique(g)
            paste(head(unique_genes, 3), collapse = ", ")
        })
    )

# Top 5 from each
top_go_plot_data <- go_combined %>%
    group_by(Regulation) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = abs(Zscore), n = 15) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(desc(Zscore))  # UP on top

# Order factor
top_go_plot_data$Description <- factor(
    top_go_plot_data$Description,
    levels = rev(top_go_plot_data$Description)
)

top_go_plot_data$Regulation <- factor(
    top_go_plot_data$Regulation,
    levels = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated")
)

# Plot
plot_go <- ggplot(top_go_plot_data, aes(x = Zscore, y = Description, fill = Regulation)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    geom_text(aes(label = GeneSymbols),
              hjust = ifelse(top_go_plot_data$Zscore > 0, -0.1, 1.1),
              size = 2, fontface = "italic") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "red", "Downregulated" = "blue")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "GO: Microglia PAP1.vs.Control",
        x = "Z-score",
        y = "GO Term",
        fill = "Regulation"
    ) +
    xlim(min(top_go_plot_data$Zscore) - 2, max(top_go_plot_data$Zscore) + 2)

plot_go

# Save as PDF
ggsave("GO_Transcriptomic_Barplot.pdf", plot = plot_go, width = 10, height = 6)
write.csv(top_go_plot_data, file = 'Top.GO.Microglia.PAP1.vs.Control.csv')
go_combined
write.csv(go_combined, file = 'GO_combined.Microglia.PAP1.vs.Control.csv')
```

```{r Astrocyte_pap1_vs_control}
### GO plot for Astrocytes_Pap1_vs_Control

### Load Required Libraries
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

### Load and prepare input data
resDF <- Astrocytes_Pap1_vs_Control
resDF$name <- resDF$...1  # Assign gene name column

### Subset UP and DOWN regulated genes
Astro.UP <- subset(resDF, Expression.Padjust == "UP")$name
Astro.DOWN <- subset(resDF, Expression.Padjust == "DOWN")$name

### Run GO Enrichment (BP, MF, CC)
go_up <- enrichGO(
  gene = Astro.UP,
  OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType = "SYMBOL",
  ont = "ALL",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff = 1,
  readable = FALSE
)

go_down <- enrichGO(
  gene = Astro.DOWN,
  OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType = "SYMBOL",
  ont = "ALL",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff = 1,
  readable = FALSE
)

### Extract results and add labels
Astro.GO_UP.result <- go_up@result %>%
  mutate(
    logFDR = -log10(p.adjust),
    Expression = "UP",
    Type = "PAP1.vs.Control"
  )

Astro.GO_Down.result <- go_down@result %>%
  mutate(
    logFDR = -log10(p.adjust),
    Expression = "DOWN",
    Type = "PAP1.vs.Control"
  )

### Save results
saveRDS(Astro.GO_UP.result, 'Astro.GO_UP.result.rds')
write.csv(Astro.GO_UP.result, 'Astro.GO_UP.result.csv')
saveRDS(Astro.GO_Down.result, 'Astro.GO_Down.result.rds')
write.csv(Astro.GO_Down.result, 'Astro.GO_Down.result.csv')

### Combine and prepare for plotting
go_combined <- bind_rows(
  Astro.GO_UP.result %>% mutate(Regulation = "Upregulated"),
  Astro.GO_Down.result %>% mutate(Regulation = "Downregulated")
)

go_combined <- go_combined %>%
  mutate(
    Zscore = ifelse(Regulation == "Downregulated", -logFDR, logFDR),
    GeneSymbols = sapply(strsplit(geneID, "/"), function(g) {
      unique_genes <- unique(g)
      paste(head(unique_genes, 3), collapse = ", ")
    })
  )

### Top 5 from each regulation
top_go_plot_data <- go_combined %>%
  group_by(Regulation) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(Zscore), n = 8) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(Zscore))

top_go_plot_data$Description <- factor(
  top_go_plot_data$Description,
  levels = rev(top_go_plot_data$Description)
)

top_go_plot_data$Regulation <- factor(
  top_go_plot_data$Regulation,
  levels = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated")
)

### Plot
plot_go <- ggplot(top_go_plot_data, aes(x = Zscore, y = Description, fill = Regulation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = GeneSymbols),
            hjust = ifelse(top_go_plot_data$Zscore > 0, -0.1, 1.1),
            size = 2, fontface = "italic") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "red", "Downregulated" = "blue")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "GO: Astrocytes PAP1.vs.Control",
    x = "Z-score",
    y = "GO Term",
    fill = "Regulation"
  ) +
  xlim(min(top_go_plot_data$Zscore) - 2, max(top_go_plot_data$Zscore) + 2)


plot_go

### Save Plot & Data
ggsave("GO_Astrocytes_Barplot.pdf", plot = plot_go, width = 10, height = 6)
write.csv(top_go_plot_data, 'Top.GO.Astrocytes.PAP1.vs.Control.csv')
write.csv(go_combined, 'GO_combined.Astrocytes.PAP1.vs.Control.csv')
```

```{r Percentage of DEG Bar plot}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

library(readr)
PAP1_DEG_Table_FINAL <- read_csv("~/Desktop/PAP1.Celltype.DEG/FINAL.Tables/PAP1.DEG.Table.FINAL.csv")

df <- PAP1_DEG_Table_FINAL

# Calculate Percent
df$Percent <- round((df$Total_Significant / df$Total_Genes) * 100, 1)

# Set custom colors matching the plot
custom_colors <- c("Astrocytes" = "firebrick",
                   "Glutamatergic Neuron" = "salmon",
                   "Microglia" = "darkgreen",
                   "Oligodendrocyte" = "cyan",
                   "GABAergic Neuron" = "blue",
                   "Oligodendrocyte Precursor" = "orange",
                   "Endothelial" = "purple")

# Create the bar plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(Celltype, -Percent), y = Percent, fill = Celltype)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Percent, "%")), 
              vjust = -0.5, size = 5, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 20, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(title = "ShK vs. PBS",
         y = "Percentage", x = NULL, fill = "Celltype") +
    # Add UP and DOWN gene labels below bars
    geom_text(aes(y = -2, label = paste0("UP: ", UP)), color = "blue", vjust = 1, size = 4.2) +
    geom_text(aes(y = -6, label = paste0("DOWN: ", DOWN)), color = "darkblue", vjust = 1, size = 4.2) +
    expand_limits(y = -8)  # Leave space at the bottom for UP/DOWN text


### PART2

library(readr)


df <- PAP1_DEG_Table_FINAL

df <- as.data.frame(df)
# Add percentage of total significant genes
df <- df %>%
    mutate(Percent_Total_Significant = round((Total_Significant / Total_Genes) * 100, 2))

# Reshape to long format
df_long <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(UP, DOWN), names_to = "Direction", values_to = "Count") %>%
    mutate(
        Percent = round((Count / Total_Genes) * 100, 2),
        Celltype = factor(Celltype, levels = df$Celltype[order(-df$Percent_Total_Significant)])
    )

# Get top labels for total significant % above the bars
df_top_labels <- df %>%
    select(Celltype, Percent_Total_Significant) %>%
    mutate(Celltype = factor(Celltype, levels = df$Celltype[order(-Percent_Total_Significant)]))

# Direction colors
direction_colors <- c("UP" = "red", "DOWN" = "steelblue")

# Plot
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Celltype, y = Percent, fill = Direction)) +
```

```{r Percentage of DEG Bar plot}
    geom_text(data = df_top_labels,
```

```{r GO plot FOR Astrocyte}
library(readr)
Astrocyte_TOP_GO_plot <- read_csv("/Users/usri/Desktop/PAP1.Celltype.DEG/NEW.Cut.off/Astrocyte.TOP.GO.plot.csv")

top_go_plot_data <- Astrocyte_TOP_GO_plot %>%
    group_by(Regulation) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(desc(Zscore))

# Step 4: Set factor levels for plotting
top_go_plot_data$Description <- factor(
    top_go_plot_data$Description,
    levels = rev(top_go_plot_data$Description)
)

top_go_plot_data$Regulation <- factor(
    top_go_plot_data$Regulation,
    levels = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated")
)

plot_go <- ggplot(top_go_plot_data, aes(x = Zscore, y = Description, fill = Regulation)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    geom_text(aes(label = GeneSymbols,
                  hjust = ifelse(Zscore > 0, -0.1, 1.1)),  # <-- fixed line
              size = 2, fontface = "italic") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "red", "Downregulated" = "blue")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "GO:Astrocyte PAP1 vs. Control",
        x = "Z-score",
        y = "GO Term",
        fill = "Regulation"
    ) +
    xlim(min(top_go_plot_data$Zscore) - 2,
         max(top_go_plot_data$Zscore) + 2)
```

```{r GABAergic GO PAP1}
### GO plot for GABA_ergic_Neuron_Pap1_vs_control

### Load Required Libraries
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

### Load and prepare input data
resDF <- GABA_ergic_Neuron_Pap1_vs_control

### Subset UP and DOWN regulated genes
GABA_ergic.UP <- subset(resDF, Expression.Padjust == "UP")$name
GABA_ergic.DOWN <- subset(resDF, Expression.Padjust == "DOWN")$name

### Run GO Enrichment (BP, MF, CC)
go_up <- enrichGO(
  gene = GABA_ergic.UP,
  OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType = "SYMBOL",
  ont = "ALL",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff = 1,
  readable = FALSE
)

go_down <- enrichGO(
  gene = GABA_ergic.DOWN ,
  OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
  keyType = "SYMBOL",
  ont = "ALL",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff = 1,
  readable = FALSE
)

### Extract results and add labels
GABA_ergic.GO.UP.result <- go_up@result %>%
  mutate(
    logFDR = -log10(p.adjust),
    Expression = "UP",
    Type = "PAP1.vs.Control"
  )

GABA_ergic.GO.DOWN.result <- go_down@result %>%
  mutate(
    logFDR = -log10(p.adjust),
    Expression = "DOWN",
    Type = "PAP1.vs.Control"
  )

### Save results
saveRDS(GABA_ergic.GO.UP.result, 'GABA_ergic.GO.UP.result.rds')
write.csv(GABA_ergic.GO.UP.result, 'GABA_ergic.GO.UP.result.csv')
saveRDS(GABA_ergic.GO.DOWN.result, 'GABA_ergic.GO.DOWN.result.rds')
write.csv(GABA_ergic.GO.DOWN.result, 'GABA_ergic.GO.DOWN.result.csv')

### Combine and prepare for plotting
go_combined <- bind_rows(
GABA_ergic.GO.UP.result %>% mutate(Regulation = "Upregulated"),
  GABA_ergic.GO.DOWN.result %>% mutate(Regulation = "Downregulated")
)

go_combined <- go_combined %>%
  mutate(
    Zscore = ifelse(Regulation == "Downregulated", -logFDR, logFDR),
    GeneSymbols = sapply(strsplit(geneID, "/"), function(g) {
```

```{r Glutamatergic GO PAP1}
  )

write.csv(go_combined, 'GO_combined.Glutamatergic_Neuron_Pap1_VS_Control.csv')

## plot GO

TOP_Glutamatergic_GO_PAP1_Final <- read_csv("~/Desktop/PAP1.Celltype.DEG/FINAL.Tables/TOP.Glutamatergic.GO.PAP1.Final.csv")

top_go_plot_data <- top_go_plot_data %>%
  distinct(Description, .keep_all = TRUE)

top_go_plot_data$Description <- factor(
  top_go_plot_data$Description,
  levels = rev(top_go_plot_data$Description)
)

top_go_plot_data$Regulation <- factor(
  top_go_plot_data$Regulation,
  levels = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated")
)

plot_go <- ggplot(top_go_plot_data, aes(x = Zscore, y = Description, fill = Regulation)) +

  geom_text(aes(label = GeneSymbols),
            hjust = ifelse(top_go_plot_data$Zscore > 0, -0.1, 1.1),
            size = 2, fontface = "italic") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "red", "Downregulated" = "blue")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "GO:Glutamatergic Neuron PAP1.vs.Control",
    x = "Z-score",
    y = "GO Term",
    fill = "Regulation"
  ) +
  xlim(min(top_go_plot_data$Zscore) - 2, max(top_go_plot_data$Zscore) + 2)
```

```{r DEG Bar Plot}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

# Read data
PAP1_DEG_Table_FINAL <- read_csv("~/Desktop/PAP1.Celltype.DEG/FINAL.Tables/PAP1.DEG.Table.FINAL.csv")
df <- PAP1_DEG_Table_FINAL

# -------------------- PART 1: Basic bar plot with UP/DOWN labels --------------------

# Calculate overall significant percent
df$Percent <- round((df$Total_Significant / df$Total_Genes) * 100, 1)

# Define custom colors by cell type
custom_colors <- c(
    "Astrocytes" = "firebrick",
    "Glutamatergic Neuron" = "salmon",
    "Microglia" = "darkgreen",
    "Oligodendrocyte" = "cyan",
    "GABAergic Neuron" = "blue",
    "Oligodendrocyte Precursor" = "orange",
    "Endothelial" = "purple"
)

# Plot Part 1
ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(Celltype, -Percent), y = Percent, fill = Celltype)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Percent, "%")), 
              vjust = -0.5, size = 5, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 20, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "ShK vs. PBS",
        y = "Percentage",
        x = NULL,
        fill = "Celltype"
    ) +
    # Add UP and DOWN labels below bars
    geom_text(aes(y = -2, label = paste0("UP: ", UP)), color = "blue", vjust = 1, size = 4.2) +
    geom_text(aes(y = -6, label = paste0("DOWN: ", DOWN)), color = "darkblue", vjust = 1, size = 4.2) +
    expand_limits(y = -8)

# -------------------- PART 2: Stacked bar plot by UP/DOWN contribution --------------------

# Add percentage of total significant genes
df <- df %>%
    mutate(Percent_Total_Significant = round((Total_Significant / Total_Genes) * 100, 2))

# Reorder Celltype by total percent
ordered_celltypes <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(Percent_Total_Significant)) %>%
    pull(Celltype)

# Long format: UP/DOWN contribution
df_long <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(UP, DOWN), names_to = "Direction", values_to = "Count") %>%
    mutate(
        Percent = round((Count / Total_Genes) * 100, 2),
        Celltype = factor(Celltype, levels = ordered_celltypes)
    )

# Labels for total percent
df_top_labels <- df %>%
    mutate(Celltype = factor(Celltype, levels = ordered_celltypes)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Celltype, Percent_Total_Significant)

# Colors for UP/DOWN bars
direction_colors <- c("UP" = "red", "DOWN" = "steelblue")

# Plot Part 2
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Celltype, y = Percent, fill = Direction)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Percent, "%")),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4, color = "white") +
    geom_text(data = df_top_labels,
              aes(x = Celltype, y = Percent_Total_Significant + 2,
                  label = paste0("Total: ", Percent_Total_Significant, "%")),
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = direction_colors) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 20, hjust = 1),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "PAP1 vs. Control",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Percentage of Total Genes"
    )
```
